Title: Research ideation (optional)
Description: 5W1H analysis + gap identification + research question definition; document in notes/ideation.md
Acceptance: Ideation doc exists with clear RQ and gap statement
Notes: Optional; skip if RQ is already defined

Title: Literature discovery
Description: Search strategy + collect candidate papers; verify relevance and recency (60%+ last 3 years)
Acceptance: Candidate list with 40+ papers; search terms documented
Notes: Record search queries and databases used

Title: Framework skeleton + Figure 1 draft
Description: Build method framework; draft Figure 1 (method overview or teaser); propose section outline
Acceptance: Figure 1 concept approved; outline consistent with contributions
Notes: Stop for user approval after Figure 1 + outline

Title: Evidence pack assembly
Description: Generate per-section evidence packs from literature notes + ref.bib
Acceptance: evidence-packs/ contains one JSON per section; citation budgets set

Title: Abstract
Description: Write 150-250 word abstract: problem, approach, key result, impact
Acceptance: Abstract covers problem/method/result; within word limit; no unverified claims
Notes: Write last or revise after all sections done

Title: Introduction
Description: Motivate problem, state gap, list 2-4 contributions, include Figure 1, add paper roadmap
Acceptance: Claims cited; contributions match experiments; Figure 1 placed; roadmap present
Notes: Figure 1 is critical for first impression

Title: Related Work
Description: Position against prior work; organize by theme or timeline; identify the gap this paper fills
Acceptance: All claims cited; fair comparison; gap clearly stated; no missing key references
Notes: Group by subtopic; cite both classic and recent work

Title: Method
Description: Formal problem setup, proposed approach, algorithm/model details, theoretical justification if applicable
Acceptance: Method is clear and reproducible; notation consistent; diagram matches text
Notes: Include pseudocode or algorithm block if applicable

Title: Experiments
Description: Setup (datasets/metrics/baselines/hyperparams), main results table, ablation studies, analysis
Acceptance: All numbers verified; baselines fairly compared; ablations justify design choices
Notes: Do not fabricate results; flag missing experiments

Title: Discussion + Limitations + Conclusion
Description: Discuss findings, failure cases, scope boundaries, societal impact (if required), future work, summary
Acceptance: Limitations are honest; conclusion matches contributions; required sections present per venue
Notes: Check venue CFP for required subsections (broader impact/ethics)

Title: Anti-AI writing scan + rewrite
Description: Scan all sections for AI-typical phrases and patterns; rewrite flagged passages
Acceptance: No AI-flagged vocabulary remains; rhythm varies; no formulaic structures
Notes: See references/writing-style.md Anti-AI Writing Discipline section

Title: Pre-review integrity gate
Description: Run privacy scan + BibTeX audit + claim registry sample (Stage 2.5)
Acceptance: `integrity_gate.py --stage pre-review` passes; no blocker verdicts

Title: Paper self-review (5 dimensions)
Description: Self-review on: novelty, clarity, soundness, significance, reproducibility; score each 1-5 and list weaknesses
Acceptance: All 5 dimensions scored; weaknesses converted to actionable issue rows
Notes: Be honest; simulate a skeptical reviewer

Title: Logic selfloop
Description: Check paragraph linkage and topic coherence within each section
Acceptance: `logic_selfloop.py` PASS; no paragraph islands

Title: Argument selfloop
Description: Verify claim-evidence chains; no orphan claims or unsupported passages
Acceptance: `argument_selfloop.py` PASS

Title: Voice selfloop
Description: Detect generator/planner voice leaks and opener monotony
Acceptance: `voice_selfloop.py` PASS; zero forbidden patterns

Title: Paper review Round 1
Description: Multi-role review: technical soundness + experimental rigor + writing clarity; convert blockers into issue rows
Acceptance: Review completed; new issue rows inserted; blockers tracked
Notes: Auto-generated by reviewer loop; do not fabricate results

Title: Paper review Round 2
Description: Camera-ready review: clarity + related work completeness + layout/figures + citations
Acceptance: No major blockers remain; compile passes; all figures readable
Notes: Stop iterating when only minor issues remain

Title: Rhythm refinement
Description: Refine prose section-by-section: cut fillers, vary sentence lengths, fix voice leaks. Apply writing-style.md + anti-ai-writing.md guidelines
Acceptance: All sections refined; citations preserved; fillers removed; voice_selfloop + anti_ai_scan --strict pass
Notes: Run only after all writing issues are DONE; see references/writing-style.md and references/anti-ai-writing.md

Title: Conference checklist compliance
Description: Verify venue-specific requirements: page limit, anonymization, supplementary format, required sections (limitations/impact/ethics/checklist)
Acceptance: All venue requirements met; checklist items checked
Notes: Download official checklist from venue website

Title: Final integrity gate
Description: 100% claim verification + strict BibTeX audit (Stage 4.5)
Acceptance: `integrity_gate.py --stage final` passes; zero blockers

Title: Process record (optional)
Description: Generate `notes/process-record.md` + fill collaboration quality table
Acceptance: process-record exists; scores filled if requested

Title: Slide material analysis + needs interview
Description: Read paper main.tex; ask duration + audience + content scope (Phase 0-1)
Acceptance: Interview completed; slide count and scope confirmed

Title: Slide structure plan
Description: Produce detailed outline: section titles + slide count + content points + planned TikZ (Phase 2)
Acceptance: User approved structure plan
Notes: GATE: do NOT draft until user approves

Title: Slide drafting
Description: Write slides in batches of 5-10; telegraphic style; self-check density per batch (Phase 3)
Acceptance: All slides drafted; notation consistent; density within bounds

Title: Slide quality loop
Description: Compile + self-review + score ≥90 + fix (max 3 rounds) (Phase 5)
Acceptance: Score ≥90; no overfull hbox >10pt; all citations resolve

Title: Slide validation
Description: Run validate_slides.py; fix all VIOLATION and CRITICAL items
Acceptance: `validate_slides.py` reports PASS or PASS WITH WARNINGS

Title: Generate narration script
Description: Parse slides.tex frames and speaker notes into narration-script.json
Acceptance: narration-script.json exists with one entry per slide

Title: Synthesize TTS audio
Description: Synthesize per-slide TTS audio + manifest.json
Acceptance: All MP3 files generated; manifest.json has correct durations
Notes: Use `python3 scripts/synthesize_tts.py --project-dir <paper_dir>`; requires GPU or --api-url; see references/video-workflow.md

Title: Scaffold Remotion project
Description: Convert PDF to PNG + copy Remotion template + generate props.json + npm install
Acceptance: slides/video/remotion/ exists with props.json and node_modules/

Title: Render video
Description: Run Remotion render to produce presentation.mp4
Acceptance: presentation.mp4 exists; H.264 1920x1080 30fps

Title: Validate video
Description: Check resolution + audio track + duration + file size
Acceptance: `validate_video.py` PASS; notes/video-validation.md generated

Title: Poster material analysis + requirements
Description: Read paper; confirm dimensions/orientation/columns/style (PS0-PS1)
Acceptance: Interview completed; dimensions confirmed

Title: Resource collection
Description: Convert figures PDF→PNG; download logos; generate QR codes (PS2)
Acceptance: All figures in poster/; QR code generated

Title: Generate poster HTML
Description: Populate template: CARD_REGISTRY + DEFAULT_LAYOUT + header (PS3)
Acceptance: poster/index.html renders; no FILL_IN placeholders

Title: Layout optimization
Description: Playwright whitespace minimization + PDF export (PS4)
Acceptance: posterAPI.getWaste() < 15%; PDF exported

Title: Quality loop + user iteration
Description: Validate score ≥85; user edits via Copy Config (PS5; max 3 rounds)
Acceptance: Score ≥85; poster-validation.md generated

Title: Poster thumbnail + final export
Description: Generate thumbnail; final PDF at print resolution
Acceptance: poster.pdf + thumbnail exist
